main_body: A hexagonal coffin lid with a cross, seen almost flat from above and tapering to the foot. It fills the whole sprite, and no front face is drawn below it.
top_band: No separate top band. Column x=8 shows an outline at row 1, then one continuous lid surface in similar mid-orange and tan tones from row 2 to about row 23, with a gold cross crossing it at rows 7-8. The bottom rows 25-29 are darker, but they read as part of the lid's tapered foot, not a front face.
evidence: The coffin is drawn as a flat top-down plan, like the red 'top-down slab' in the guide. The lid and cross fill the body, with no lighter top band above a distinct front face. The 1-row line at row 24 and the darker rows 25-29 are only the foot end of the lid, not a vertical south face. No front-edge line, eave shadow or recessed front is present. Fails the 3/4 contract as a top-down plan.

style.evidence: The outline is a dark brown tint (#411e05), and the 0% neutral share confirms it is not near-black. The wood ramp has only about 4 steps (tan, orange, brown, dark brown) plus the gold cross. It has 10 distinct colours and a median of 8 per tile, against 38-40 colours and 17-20 per tile in the references, so it is well below them. The lid is mostly smooth bands with little grain or speckle, though flat-fill coverage is 0%. Next to the stall and the well it looks thinner and flatter, so it fails.
